sources.title: Closed date-confirmation task and date/time exercise
sources.details: The section defines completion as copying an explicitly supplied date into a confirmation. An unspecified date has no unique required confirmation value; the question supplies that missing value. Extending the declared required fields to date and time gives two binary presence flags, 2*2=4 states; query exactly the missing labels. This is a local target/rubric design, not evidence for all conversational clarification decisions.
